From Cheap Trick · Price: your stand must touch the target's back.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: your stand leaps onto a creature's back unseen, @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] as it lands (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), and rides it on a failure; you hear what it hears, the creature takes –2 to attack rolls against your stand while it rides, and it can't turn to face what's on its back: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn (for as long as the stand rides on a critical failure), and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} by the voice at its ear.
  • 5: Surge: the stand screams into its ear (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}): @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}), and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} on a success, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 3} on a critical failure.
  • 9: It can't see your stand at all. 1 action: the stand makes it drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 13: While the stand rides, the creature can't reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened} value below 1.
  • 17: Attacks against your stand while it rides a creature also hit that creature: it takes the same damage.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.qxGSykRFrJuQp5D0]{Effect: Back Rider}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
